title: Tell HN: GitHub refuses to remove cracked copies of my software after a month
summary: A developer of Photopea, a web-based photo editor, reports that GitHub refuses to remove dozens of repositories containing cracked versions of their software with ads removed, despite reporting them over a month ago.
problem_solved: This is a complaint about GitHub's inadequate response to copyright infringement reports, not a solution to a problem.
why_valuable: Highlights the challenges independent developers face when trying to protect their software from piracy on major platforms like GitHub.
